chunks: They will say: 'God's.' Say: 'Then why are you so deluded?'
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'Then why are you so deluded?' in Surah Al-Mu'minun?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse critiques the cognitive dissonance of polytheists who verbally acknowledge Allah’s sovereignty yet remain entrapped in 'suhur' (delusion or being overtaken by error) due to their blind adherence to ancestral traditions. It underscores the distinction between nominal monotheism and true, conscious submission, highlighting how intellectual laziness leads to spiritual misguidance despite clear theological premises.
